item.text: {"search_note":"I found clear programmatic language in the manifesto, planning documents, and “smart services” rollout. I did not find a separate 2024 doctrinal paper that cleanly states a hidden theory of regime control; that part has to be inferred from election behavior, the neutral-authority refusal, and the July crackdown. The best-supported reading is therefore: explicit development-state ideology on paper, with strong revealed incentives to preserve personalized control in practice.","evidence":[{"title":"AL unveils Smart Bangladesh manifesto","publisher":"BSS","date":"December 27, 2023","url":"https://www.bssnews.net/news-flash/165179","summary":"Hasina promised a “developed, prosperous, Smart Bangladesh” by 2041 and a high-middle-income country by 2031.
